LKL Period Scores

Source: R/lkl.R
lkl_period_scores.Rd

Points each team scored in each period of a game, overtime included.

Endpoint: GET https://lkl.lt/api/livestream/boxscore/{game_id}

Usage

lkl_period_scores(game_id)

Arguments

game_id

Required. lkl.lt game id (integer), e.g. 11446; game_id in lkl_results. Not sequential by season before 2018-19. Only a finished game is served.

Value

A hoopR_data tibble. One row per team and period (home first, periods ascending). points is the points scored IN the period, not cumulative. period 1-4 is regulation (period_type regular); 5 is the first overtime, 6 the second (overtime). A body without period scores gives a zero-row tibble. Every column below is always present (a zero-row tibble keeps them and their types); an answer with nothing in it raises hoopR_no_data, as in sportsdataverse-py.

col_nametypedescription
game_idintegerlkl.lt game id (key space: LKL games; the {gameId} of every route). Not sequential by season before 2018-19; not the Genius matchId. A frame parsed from a bare body has a null game_id when the body does not echo it (the runtime stamps it under _request).
team_idintegerlkl.lt team id (key space: lkl.lt clubs, STABLE across seasons and renamings: 6 = Rytas). Joins lkl_game_info home_team_id / away_team_id; not the Genius team id. Null on a frame parsed from a bare body.
team_sidecharacterSide of the game the row belongs to: home or away (the game page's teams_info side; the box score, leaders and plays say home / away, and gameStatistics is keyed by team id so the runtime supplies the side).
periodintegerPeriod number: 1-4 regulation, 5 the first overtime, 6 the second.
period_typecharacterregular for periods 1-4, overtime from period 5.
pointsintegerPoints the team scored IN this period (not cumulative); keyed by period in the site's quarter_scores.

Details

Unofficial and unsupported: these are the routes lkl.lt's own game page calls (found in its front-end bundle) and its server-rendered pages. The site's robots.txt allows everything and sets no crawl-delay; the runtime still spaces requests at least 1 s apart. The site's terms were not reviewed; check them before you republish the data.

Coverage: game wrappers serve FINISHED games only (an unfinished game raises hoopR_asset_fetch). The box score, summary, score line, statistics and leaders answer for every season from 1993-94 (before 2024-25 the scoring splits and lead statistics are 0). Play-by-play and shots exist from 2024-25 only; an earlier finished game raises hoopR_no_data. From 2016-17 the results season id is also the Genius LiveStats competition id (see the genius family) which holds play-by-play for older games; lkl.lt game, team and player ids are lkl.lt's own and do not join Genius ids. The King Mindaugas Cup shares the routes but is not wrapped. Text fields are Lithuanian.

Errors: hoopR_no_data when lkl.lt has nothing for the request (HTTP 404, an unknown game or standings season, a season the site's selects do not list, a season without played games, a finished game before 2024-25 asked for play-by-play or shots); hoopR_bad_request for a game id or season that is not an integer, or HTTP 400 / 422; hoopR_asset_fetch when the fetch failed or the answer is not the one asked for (an unfinished game, a body or page for another game or season, an error or changed body, a truncated results list). All inherit hoopR_error. Dates and times are Lithuanian local (Europe/Vilnius) as the site prints them.

See also
